alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

tool_errors: logs: logs: /ecs/checkout: An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the FilterLogEvents operation: User: <ARN_1> is not authorized to perform

root_cause.hypothesis: Service checkout looks healthy at alarm time (tasks_running==tasks_desired, 0 pending, 0 failed deployments) with one deployment in flight — CPU near 0% is the odd signal. Likely a transient/low-traffic dip or CPU-utilization-low threshold false positive, not a crash or bad deploy. No recent deploys and no log lines to corroborate any real failure.
evidence: tasks_running (2.0) == tasks_desired (2.0), tasks_pending 0.0 → no scaling/placement problem
deployments_failed 0.0, deployments_in_flight 1.0 → deploy in progress but not failing
cpu_utilization_pct ~0.0056% → essentially idle, unusual for prod checkout
RECENT DEPLOYS empty and LOGS empty → no corroborating signal for root cause
ruled_out: Memory exhaustion (mem ~58%, well under typical thresholds)

proposal.reasoning: tasks_running==tasks_desired(2/2), 0 pending, 0 failed deploys, mem normal. Only odd signal near-0 CPU, likely low-traffic dip or bad CPU-low threshold, not crash/bad deploy. No logs/deploys corroborate real failure.
proposal.expected_effect: No change; alarm self-clears if transient. If CPU stays ~0 next period, revisit threshold or escalate.

reasons: Action is inert or advisory; no approval required.
